messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — Elevated 5xx rate observed for customer Veridian on cluster us-west-2-dedicated-37. Spike detected at 02:09 UTC. Current 5xx rate ~18%. Observed KV cache evictions and GPU memory pressure. Paging on-call: @elena

elena: on it. pulling up dashboards and logs now. which tenant/route is the hot path?

mike: veridian/production-route-1 is the source. I see repeated upstream resets and kv_cache evictions. CPU fine, GPU memory at 96% on node gpu-37.

rahul: quick check — is there a scheduled backfill or refresh for Veridian? repeated large prefix prompts can thrash KV cache.

sophia: yep — their support team scheduled a nightly "veridian-model-refresh" batch at 02:05 UTC. It spikes concurrent requests to a small set of models.

ops-liz: logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-14T02:08:56Z] gpu-37 kernel: OOM warning: GPU memory pressure -> kv_cache evictions=3421
[2026-03-14T02:09:03Z] ingress-gateway: upstream reset, code=ECONNRESET, model=gpt-d-13b
[2026-03-14T02:09:10Z] scheduler: model-instance-alloc fail: no free kv slots
```

elena: ok, likely background job thrashing KV cache causing tail latency/timeouts -> 5xx. mitigation plan: 1) throttle Veridian concurrency at edge 2) shift a portion of traffic to fallback model variant 3) scale cluster temporarily 4) coordinate with Veridian to pause the refresh job. I'll execute 1–3 now.

mike: executing throttle at gateway (temporary):
```yaml
gateway:
  rate_limit:
    tenants:
      veridian:
        rps: 8
```
applied via console.

mike: setting tenant concurrency quota:
```
redwoodctl routing set-tenant-quota --tenant veridian --concurrency 12
```

rahul: applying partial reroute to fallback model (30%):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"cluster":"us-west-2-dedicated-37","tenant":"veridian","fallback_model":"gpt-open-7b-quant","pct_route":30}'
```

elena: scaling cluster by +2 nodes (best-effort, autoscale will rebalance):
```bash
redwoodctl clusters scale --name us-west-2-dedicated-37 --add-nodes 2
```

incident-bot: Status update — throttling + partial reroute + scale initiated. Notifying on-call SREs.

veridian-support: Confirmed — we saw the alert and paused the "veridian-model-refresh" job at 02:16 UTC. We also disabled the scheduled sync for the next 2 hours. Customer ops notified and accepting temporary slowdown.

mike: after throttle + reroute + pause, 5xx dropped from 18% -> 2% over 6 minutes. KV evictions fall to ~120/min. Latency p50/p95 trending down.

sophia: monitoring traces — most errors were kv-cache misses + model instance hot restarts. fallback model serving looks stable.

elena: summary for handoff:
- Impact: Veridian experienced elevated 5xx/timeouts due to background refresh job causing KV cache thrashing and GPU memory pressure on us-west-2-dedicated-37. Customer-facing APIs degraded (5xx up to 18%).
- Mitigations applied: gateway rate-limit (rps=8), tenant concurrency cap (12), partial reroute 30%->gpt-open-7b-quant, scaled cluster +2 nodes, Veridian paused background job.
- Current state: 5xx ~2%, latency nearing baseline. Autoscale in flight, additional nodes expected in ~3–5 min.
- Next actions: keep throttles in place until autoscale stabilizes and we confirm KV eviction rate <50/min. Coordinate with Veridian to move refresh to off-peak or shard it.

elena: handing over monitoring to rahul for the next 4 hours. rahul — please watch dashboards (kv_evictions, gpu_mem, 5xx_rate) and escalate if 5xx >5% for >5m.

rahul: acknowledged. I'll keep a 30m cadence check and post updates. opening incident ticket INC-23789 and linking this thread.

incident-bot: Incident INC-23789 created and linked. Severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation but keep watch.

veridian-support: Customer ops confirmed they will not re-enable refresh until we give a green light. They appreciate the quick response.

elena: thanks team. if anything flares, ping the channel and I'll jump back in. handing off. :white_check_mark:
